summary: Verified three enhancements end-to-end against the live GitHub audit of mishraramesh-design/myauction-node. Backend (pytest 8/8 pass in /app/backend/tests/test_enhancements.py): (1) Re-audit idempotency — two sequential POST /api/repo-audit/ingest return the SAME project.id ('0076fe80-f911-4677-b977-39cedc918241') and GET /api/projects contains exactly one source=github_live project for this repo. (2) Broader secrets — CTRL-06 Secrets Detection has FAIL findings with evidence types under secret:* (unquoted docker-compose creds detected); project.integrity_tier=='T1'. (3) Spec ingestion — CTRL-01, CTRL-11, CTRL-15, CTRL-16, CTRL-17, CTRL-18 all present with real PASS/FAIL verdicts (no NOT_ASSESSED) and non-empty level2_status. Gates G2 and G6 now status 'At Risk' (previously would be Not Assessed); G4 also 'At Risk'. MLOps regression: secrets detector precision=1.0, f1=0.8 unchanged; rule_pack evaluate f1=0.8. Frontend /repo-audit: prefilled URL, Run Live Audit → repo-audit-result renders stack profile (Express/FastAPI/PostgreSQL/React, 100 files/~12,855 LOC), findings summary with 83 findings and by-control list containing all 7 required labels (Requirements & API Spec Quality, Unit Test Adequacy, Security Testing (DAST), Secrets Detection, Performance Threshold Check, Accessibility Check, AI Model Evaluation), both report-author and report-team_lead cards visible, 10 gate cards with G2/G4/G6/G8 'At Risk', G1 'Ready'. Re-run from UI did NOT create a duplicate project (count stayed at 1). Regression pages /harness, /model-settings, /mlops, /ledger, /findings, /gates all load with 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Re-audit-in-place is correctly implemented: ingest_repo matches by (repo_url, source=github_live), deletes dependent rows (findings/events/reports/repo_audits) and reuses the same project id — no orphan rows observed and project count stays at 1 after multiple runs.

Secret scanner's new 'sensitive_assignment_unquoted' pattern correctly fires on docker-compose unquoted values (DB_PASSWORD/JWT_SECRET) while still excluding pure env refs and placeholder-only values (tier=T1 is set, 4 critical CTRL-06 findings).

compute_gate_status mapping CTRL-01→G2 and CTRL-15/16/17/18→G6 is working — both gates now report real statuses instead of Not Assessed. Suggest adding a unit test that asserts the explicit mapping to prevent future regressions.
Spec-derived findings for CTRL-01/11/15/16/17/18 all carry both verdict and level2_status (no NOT_ASSESSED leakage) — good.
No regression in /api/mlops/metrics detectors or rule_pack evaluate; secrets precision/f1 unchanged at 1.0/0.8.
seed_data_creation: Two live ingests of myauction-node run during tests; both resolve to the same existing project id (no duplicates created).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_enhancements.py covers the three new features and MLOps regression. Needs REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env var. Each live ingest ~15-30s on this repo (two full ingests run per module). Project id to look up for myauction-node currently: 0076fe80-f911-4677-b977-39cedc918241 (source=github_live). The by-control labels on /repo-audit now include 7 extra controls — any removal would be a regression.
